pages.text: $(l)Bubonic$(): rat bites, the fleas in blighted soil, handling the dead.$(br)$(l)Pneumonic$(): miasma clouds, and the coughs of the sick.$(br)$(l)Septicemic$(): blows from the Afflicted.$(br)$(l)Dysentery$(): rotten flesh, raw meat, and water drunk near a plague nest.$(br2)Only the two plagues of the breath and the bubo are caught from coughing people.

pages.name: Plague Rat
pages.text: Fast and fragile. Terrified of cats. Its tail fetches a bounty from any Plague Doctor.
